decision_rationale: The record describes use of a "generative RNA LM" to identify functional RNA mutations, which supports a genuinely generative model. The contribution appears to be applying that model to a downstream mutation-identification task rather than presenting a new foundation model.
evidence_snippet: "two distinct deep learning frameworks, a GNN and a generative RNA LM, could be used to identify functional RNA mutations"; title: "RNA language models predict mutations that improve RNA function."
